Start up your defenses and prepare for the worst.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 1 (Formerly, [[Polluted Wasteland II|Nuclear]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Wastewalker''', internally referred to as '''Mutated''', which is still used for its legacy version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, is the first enemy the player faces in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has high health and an above average speed. The '''Wastewalker''' could be spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. ==Appearance== The '''Wastewalker''' has a chartreuse skin color and a black torso and legs. Veins are visible on its head and arms. It is faceless and it emits light green particles. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |3.5 |- !Wave !Health |- |2 |74 |- |3 |77 |- |4 |81 |- |5 |84 |- |6 |88 |- |7 |91 |- |8 |95 |- |9 |98 |- |10 |102 |- |11 |105 |- |12 |109 |- |13 |112 |- |14 |116 |- |15 |119 |- |16 |123 |- |17 |126 |- |18 |130 |- |19 |133 |- |20 |137 |- |21 |140 |- |22 |144 |- |23 |147 |- |24 |151 |- |25 |154 |} ==Strategy== *As [[Polluted Wasteland II]] has the [[HP Locked]] modifier and the '''Wastewalker''' has quite high health, it is not possible to let even a single wave of '''Wastewalkers''' reach the exit. *Strong early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Golden Cowboy]], [[Engineer]] or [[Mortar]] can clear this out quite easily. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMutated.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- ☢️ NUCLEAR Update!☢️|'''Wastewalker''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMutated.png|'''Wastewalker''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Mutated''' Added. *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **Modern version added. ***None of the changes are applied to the legacy version. **Name changed from ''Mutated'' to ''Wastewalker''. **Health increased from 14 to 50. **Now gives {{Money|50}} on death. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''5 March 2025''' - [[v1.56.0]] **Health decreased from 50 to 40. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Health increased from 40 to 70. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. {{PollutedWasteland|Start|N/A|Wastewalker & [[Wasterunner]]|Wave 1|[[Hazardous]]|Wave 3}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
